contea di ritrovamento: Cumbria (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP TRAIANO AVG GER DAC P M TR P COS V P P ; R/ SPQR OPTIMO PRINCIPI

Silver denarius of Trajan dating AD103-11(Reece period 5 [96-117]). Obv legend: IMP TRAIANO AVG GER DAC P M TR P COS V P P. Reverse description Mournful Dacian seated at foot of trophy. Reverse legend: SPQR OPTIMO PRINCIPI. Mint Rome ( RIC 2(1) (Trajan), 220; AD 103-11). The diameter is 17m and the weight 2.07g
